summary: Completed comprehensive Phase 3 testing for WatchNexus Licensing Server. All Phase 3 features (Stripe webhooks, email delivery module, per-route rate limits, API key IP allowlist) are working correctly. Backend: 50/50 tests passed. Frontend: All Phase 3 UI features verified. Phase 2 regression tests passed.

pre_existing_issues.issue: 401 errors when loading static JS bundles at /portal route
pre_existing_issues.note: Pre-existing issue, not related to Phase 3 changes. Admin portal and all Phase 3 features work correctly.
